environment.description: CI/CD runner (GitLab Runner 15.x, shell executor) on Ubuntu 22.04 with default kernel configuration. Runner process executes as 'gitlab-runner' user with write access to /var/lib/ci-runner/ and home directories. No MAC framework loaded. ASLR enabled but heap layout is deterministic due to single-threaded artifact processing. glibc 2.35 tcache allows reliable exploitation of double-free.

config.aslr: enabled but heap deterministic for single-thread
